concepts.title: True-shape triangle
concepts.instruction: Draw the 80 mm longest edge ab and locate c by the 30°/60° triangle construction, retaining the enclosing rectangle.

concepts.title: Edge elevation
concepts.instruction: Project a, b and c to the line on XY because the lamina lies horizontally.

concepts.title: Isometric enclosing rectangle
concepts.instruction: Draw the view baseline and the isometric image of the plan rectangle.

concepts.title: Transfer the third point
concepts.instruction: Locate C from its two rectangular offsets. A non-isometric edge must be located by its endpoints, not measured directly along its oblique image.

concepts.title: Join the triangle
concepts.instruction: Draw AB, BC and CA individually.

concepts.title: Reduced triangle
concepts.instruction: Construct the scale, then repeat the bounding rectangle and vertex transfers using reduced lengths.

concepts.title: Complete labels
concepts.instruction: Add A, B, C and the 80/iso 80 dimension annotations.

notes: The 80 mm label is on the longest edge/hypotenuse in the supplied plan. Treat this as the authoritative intended interpretation.
If a numerical reference is needed for an exact right triangle with an 80 mm hypotenuse, the legs are 40 mm and 40sqrt(3) mm. The reference sketch is not to scale.
